analysis: The PR's only visible change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head lines 296-297) is a documentation clarification: `darkbloom switch` scans local models in the running daemon's config `model_cache_directory`. Units 8 and 9 (head lines 405-1308) are surrounding unchanged text and were examined for context. I found no new security behavior, code, or control change, and no weakened mitigation. The claim is consistent with the existing model-cache-location contract (`darkbloom models location`, lines 477-484 and 1159-1197) and with the daemon-authoritative config path. The doc references the T-012 weight-substitution area only indirectly: a custom cache directory on external or operator-selected storage is already in the threat model as operator-controlled. Switch validates local artifacts before admission, per the surrounding text. No threat-model assumptions are invalidated. Remaining questions I could not verify from the supplied evidence: whether the implementation (ModelSwitch or the daemon) actually scans only the configured cache directory and runs integrity verification on models found there. Those are outside the supplied docs-only diff, so no finding is raised. Related text on logout, drain, and the T-041 cache was not changed by this PR.
